crossRefs.note: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.…
You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because…
that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of…
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will…
“Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show…
“Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which…
He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject…

translations.web: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
translations.bsb: Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.
translations.kjv: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
translations.asv: Put me in remembrance; let us plead together: set thou forth thy cause, that thou mayest be justified.
